⚙ Cloud Setup
☁️
Connect to Google Sheets & Drive
Follow the 5-step guide below, then paste your Apps Script URL to go live. All estimates will save to your Google Sheet and job folders will be created in Google Drive automatically.
Step-by-Step Setup Guide
Step 1 — Create your Google Sheet
Go to sheets.google.com → New spreadsheet → Name it "FencePro Jobs"
Copy the Sheet ID from the URL (long string between /d/ and /edit)

Step 2 — Create your Drive folder
Go to drive.google.com → New folder → Name it "FencePro Jobs"
Open the folder → Copy the folder ID from the URL (after /folders/)

Step 3 — Create the Apps Script
In your Google Sheet → Extensions → Apps Script
Delete the default code → Paste the entire Code.gs file provided
Replace SHEET_ID and ROOT_FOLDER_ID with your IDs from Steps 1 & 2

Step 4 — Deploy as Web App
In Apps Script → Deploy → New deployment → Type: Web App
Execute as: Me | Who has access: Anyone → Deploy
Copy the Web App URL provided

Step 5 — Paste URL below & connect
Your Apps Script URL
🔐 Access Control
Only Google accounts listed here can log into FencePro. Your owner account is always allowed and cannot be removed.
☁️ Full System Backup / Restore
Exports everything — estimates, contacts, invoices, job costs, settings, and all app data — into a single file. Use this to move your data to a new device or the hosted version of FencePro.
🔧 Data Migration
Run this after any app update to ensure all locally stored job records use the current field format. Safe to run at any time — no data is deleted or changed, only standardized.
Estimates Backup
Estimates auto-sync from Google Sheets when connected. Use these buttons as an additional safety net.
Download Backend Code
